name: Tubal
brief: A nation, descendant of Japheth, known for trading
short: Tubal, a nation descended from Japheth, known for trading in slaves and bronze, and allied with Gog in the prophecy of Ezekiel (<ref="Gen. 10:2; Isa. 66:19; Ezek. 27:13; 38:2-3; 39:1">Gen. 10:2; Isa. 66:19; Ezek. 27:13; 38:2-3; 39:1</ref>).
